scope: Node lifetime snapshots after load and audit queries; not exact simultaneous load-boundary deltas. Raw UDP payload excludes IP/UDP headers. Client is excluded unless client_io fields are present. Repeated equal body attempts are not proof of unnecessary delivery.

latency_us.definition: first native wire-frame submission attempt to slowest of four receipt-query observations; includes initial execution/consensus wait and bounded observer; not an internal finality timestamp

client_before.scope: current poll thread; lifetime inclusive sampled wall time; nested phases are not additive; not CPU time

traffic.scope: current thread; wire_sent/received and blocked are immediate UDP only; sealed/authenticated include bound carriers; bytes include secure envelope, exclude IP/UDP headers; blocked/deferred bytes are attempts, NOT sent bytes; stages overlap, do not sum stages

client_after.scope: current poll thread; lifetime inclusive sampled wall time; nested phases are not additive; not CPU time

traffic.scope: current thread; wire_sent/received and blocked are immediate UDP only; sealed/authenticated include bound carriers; bytes include secure envelope, exclude IP/UDP headers; blocked/deferred bytes are attempts, NOT sent bytes; stages overlap, do not sum stages

client_delta_scope: Same client poll thread immediately before/after the timed drive; all four client sessions share this thread. Do not combine as a synchronized window with node lifetime snapshots.
